lemma gcd_dvd_linear_combination (d a b x y : ℕ) 
    (h1 : d ∣ a) (h2 : d ∣ b) : d ∣ a * x + b * y := by -- Approach 2: Use existing divisibility lemmas
    have hx : d ∣ a * x := dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h1 x
    have hy : d ∣ b * y := dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h2 y
    exact dvd_add hx hy
